segments.caption: Look up useful notes before you answer.
segments.spoken: RAG means retrieval augmented generation. In plain English: look up useful notes before you answer.

segments.caption: Retrieval finds the useful pages.
segments.spoken: Imagine a notebook library. A question pulls the most useful pages. That step is retrieval.

segments.caption: The pages add context.
segments.spoken: Those pages add context: fresh, relevant notes beside the question.

segments.caption: Retrieve. Add context. Generate.
segments.spoken: Then the model generates an answer from that context. Retrieve. Add context. Generate.
